intent: Borrow the restrained palette and main/side-note organization of the explicitly synthetic diagnostic reference for a simple three-node framework example.
preserve: Keep the proposed Input → Encoder → Output relationship and exact labels; this is not a reported paper result.

references.title: Synthetic diagnostic reference
references.locator: Whole test image; declared rectangular regions
references.inspectionNote: A deliberately constructed diagnostic image with a title region, a larger left area, a quieter right area and three flat design colors; not a real poster or scientific result.
references.use: Palette values and main/supporting-region hierarchy only.
references.avoidCopy: Do not print source diagnostic words or copy source content as facts.

regions.label: Main region
regions.note: More space for the principal visual.

observations.finding: Warm pale ground, dark green main ink and one amber accent distinguish roles.
observations.apply: Use pale ground for the canvas, green for type/structure and amber for a processing emphasis.

observations.finding: The main region receives more area than the supporting region.
observations.apply: Keep the pipeline primary and any explanation subordinate; adapt to the example's ordered path rather than copying source boxes.
